jobs.title: Retail Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Retail Project Coordinator

**GoldUnion US – Beverly Hills**

GoldUnion, a global leader in buying and selling precious metals, is rapidly expanding across California, with a goal of opening **25 locations by 2027**. We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Retail Project Coordinator to support and oversee our retail expansion efforts across the state.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working on-site, solving practical problems, and being directly involved in getting retail spaces ready for business.

**Position Overview**

As part of GoldUnion’s retail expansion team, the Retail Project Coordinator plays a key role in managing and supporting the build-out and launch of new branch locations. This position is focused on project coordination, vendor management, timeline tracking, and ensuring operational readiness from planning through grand opening.

This is a field-based role with a home base in **Beverly Hills, CA**, requiring **frequent travel** between branch locations throughout California. A company vehicle will be provided.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and oversee multiple retail expansion projects from pre-construction through store opening
* Work closely with contractors, vendors, and internal teams to ensure projects stay on schedule and meet company standards
* Track project timelines, deliverables, and milestones, ensuring timely completion of all phases
* Conduct site visits and walkthroughs to monitor progress, identify issues, and ensure quality control
* Serve as a point of contact between operations, construction teams, and external partners
* Assist in resolving on-site challenges and ensuring projects move forward efficiently
* Support final setup and readiness of new locations prior to opening
* Ensure each branch meets operational, safety, and brand standards before launch
* Travel between locations as needed to support multiple active projects

**Candidate Profile**

* Previous experience in project coordination, facilities coordination, construction, or retail build-outs preferred
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
* Experience working with contractors, vendors, or cross-functional teams
* Able to follow instructions, coordinate with others, and communicate clearly with internal teams
* Flexible schedule and willing to travel extensively across California
* Experience in retail expansion or construction project environments is a plus
* Strong work ethic, positive attitude, and willingness to learn are essential

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Salary:** $55,000 per year
* Company car provided
* Gas and hotels fully covered during travel

**Working Hours**

* Full-time, Monday through Friday 10am-6pm
* Occasional weekends based on business needs and branch opening schedules

**Location**

* Office currently based in **Beverly Hills, CA**
* Frequent travel to branch sites throughout California required

**Recruitment Process**

* Initial phone or video interview
* In-person interview with the operations leadership team

**Required Notices (California & Federal):**

GoldUnion is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available as required by law.

GoldUnion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act. Background screenings and applicant information are handled in accordance with applicable laws.

The listed pay range reflects GoldUnion’s good-faith estimate for this position. Actual pay may vary based on lawful job-related factors. Commission and incentive earnings are performance-based and not guaranteed.

Offers of employment are contingent upon applicable lawful onboarding requirements and screenings.

Pay: $20.00 - $26.44 per hour

* Paid time off

jobs.title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker - Parent/Caregiver Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Description**

The UCLA Health Rape Treatment Center provides specialized services for child and adult victims of sexual assault and abuse and conducts prevention, education, and professional training designed to reduce sexual violence and strengthen community response. Prevention programming includes education for youth and other community audiences, training and consultation for schools and partner organizations, and collaboration with community and professional systems.

Come join our outreach team as a Parent/Caregiver Program Coordinator and make a difference in the community. This key role will develop, coordinate, and deliver sexual abuse prevention education to parents and caregivers.

Key duties include:

* Identifying opportunities to reach parent/caregiver audiences through community organizations, healthcare, schools and child-serving settings, and other community-based venues
* Assesses prevention-education needs and develops programming responsive to those needs.
* Creating and adapting prevention curricula and materials, facilitating workshops and trainings, developing community partnerships, evaluating program effectiveness, and contributing to ongoing program improvement.
* Uses trauma informed approaches to respond appropriately to disclosures, connect families with clinical advocacy and community resources and supports caregiver engagement services.
* Contributes to grant reporting and data requirements.
* Regularly travels to local schools, community organizations, partner agencies, and other program sites throughout Los Angeles County; occasionally travel outside the local area may be required for training, meetings, or other program-related activities.
* Participation in the RTC/Stuart House 24-hour on-call response system, including approximately 1-2 weekday overnight on-call shifts per month.

UCLA Health is a world-renowned health system with four award-winning hospitals and dozens of primary care practices, specialty practices, urgent care centers and other ancillary locations throughout metro Los Angeles. We are also home to the David Geffen School of Medicine, an internationally respected leader in medical education and research. Through the efforts of our outstanding people, we have become Los Angeles’ trusted provider of exceptional, compassionate patient care.

Pay Range: $58.41 - $69.80 hourly

  
Pay range: $58.41 - $69.80 an hour  
  
**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* Master of Social Work (MSW) degree from an accredited institution and current California Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW)
* Bilingual English/Spanish proficiency sufficient to deliver prevention programming and communicate effectively with participants (ability to successfully complete the UCLA language proficiency assessment)
* 2+ years providing education, support, outreach or programming primarily to parent/caregivers or families
* Experience developing and facilitating educational programs, workshops, curricula, or training materials
* Experience in childhood trauma, child sexual abuse, or related prevention programming
* Live Scan Fingerprint screening, Criminal Record, Sex Offender Registry, and Child Abuse Index Clearance
* Per funding agency requirements and alliances, all staff must complete background checks at least every five years that includes, sex offender registry check, State or FBI criminal history check, including fingerprint check, child abuse and neglect state registry check if available in the state of California.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with parents/caregivers, schools, community organizations, healthcare providers, and multidisciplinary partners.
* Strong written communication, organizational, project-management, and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently in community and off-site settings while managing multiple concurrent activities and deadlines.

**Preferred:** Experience working with parents/caregivers and community-based organizations.

jobs.title: Program Specialist I, II, III
jobs.description:
**Job Title(s):** Part-Time Program Specialist I, II, III

**Reports to:** Operations Department

**Wages:** $19.00 - $26.00 Hourly \*Actual wages are based upon level of education and or experience\*

**Position Summary:**

The Part-Time **Program Specialist I, II, III** provides individualized support to individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities through one-on-one coaching, skill development, educational support, employment preparation, independent living, and community-based activities. The Program Specialist helps individuals work toward their personal goals while providing support across a variety of settings and maintaining accurate documentation of support, progress, and services.

Some key responsibilities of this role are providing direct educational support, including assistance with school participation, academic activities, organization, communication, assignments, and educational routines; promoting independent living skills; and supporting with Community Integration and Employment Goals. The Program Specialist adapts instruction and support to fit each individual's needs and learning style while promoting independence.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* **Facilitate virtual check-ins and video sessions with individuals and families to assess progress, review personal goals, and determine support needs.**

You will lead regular individual and family video sessions to build rapport, monitor progress, review goals, and identify changing support needs using trauma-informed, person-centered communication. Bilingual English/Spanish communication will support clear and culturally responsive engagement.

* **Provide direct individualized educational support to individuals.**

You will provide one-on-one educational support based on each individual's needs, abilities, learning style, and goals, including school routines, classroom participation, assignments, organization, and time management. Support should encourage participation while promoting independence.

* **Support individuals in developing academic and educational skills.**

You will help individuals develop communication, organization, task completion, problem-solving, self-advocacy, study habits, and other skills that support educational success. Instruction will be adapted to each individual's learning style and support needs.

* **Plan and lead individualized coaching sessions focused on employment readiness, independent living, educational success, and personal development.**

You will provide structured, goal-driven coaching based on each individual's strengths, needs, and goals, including areas such as interview preparation, budgeting, communication, organization, educational participation, and daily living. Coaching should be adapted to the individual's learning style while tracking progress and outcomes.

* **Utilize individualized teaching and instructional techniques to support learning and skill development.**

You will use appropriate strategies such as modeling, prompting, repetition, reinforcement, and step-by-step instruction to help individuals learn and practice new skills while gradually increasing independence.

* **Support individuals with educational routines, schedules, and responsibilities.**

You will assist individuals with following educational schedules, transitioning between activities, preparing materials, completing assignments, managing time, and maintaining routines that promote greater independence.

* **Conduct virtual work readiness training, including mock interviews, resume workshops, and job search support.**

You will provide training in resume development, interview preparation, digital literacy, and online job searches, with opportunities for one-on-one coaching and support as needed.

* **Provide individualized instruction and skill training across educational, community, employment, and daily living environments.**

You will help individuals develop and apply skills across educational, community, employment, and daily living settings, including hygiene, cooking, laundry, mobility, community navigation, social skills, and employment-related skills.

* **Design and implement engaging remote community-based activities, and support transitions to in-person programming when needed.**

You will create and facilitate accessible virtual activities that encourage social connection, engagement, and community participation, while providing continuity and support when individuals transition to in-person programming.

* **Collaborate with on-site staff, job coaches, and program coordinators to coordinate seamless service delivery.**

You will communicate updates, share documentation, and collaborate with team members to maintain consistency in support plans and services. Bilingual communication may also help strengthen coordination with Spanish-speaking families.

* **Set measurable weekly and monthly objectives to help individuals build communication, life, educational, and employment skills.**

You will help individuals establish achievable goals related to communication, daily living, education, employment, and personal development. Progress will be monitored and goals adjusted as needed, with support provided in the individual's preferred language when appropriate.

* **Track and document individual progress, support needs, and goals using internal agency systems.**

You will maintain accurate, timely, objective, and confidential records of individual progress, support needs, goals, observations, and follow-up requirements using agency systems.

* **Submit accurate monthly progress notes, service logs, and activity calendars in compliance with agency deadlines.**

You will complete and submit timely documentation reflecting sessions, training, coaching, educational support, and other services provided while following agency formats and deadlines.

* **Create accessible learning materials such as visual aids, slides, and training tools using Canva, Google Slides, or Pow

jobs.title: Dental Treatment & Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overview**

At Overhill Dental, every smile has a story. We provide comprehensive and cosmetic dental care centered on health, confidence, and an exceptional patient experience. We are looking for a dependable, resourceful individual who enjoys connecting with people and helping them move confidently through their care.

You will coordinate the patient journey from the first inquiry through treatment scheduling, payment, and follow-up. This role combines patient service, treatment coordination, and front office administration. You will work closely with the dentist and clinical team to keep patients informed, schedules productive, and administrative details accurate.

**Duties:**

**Treatment coordination and follow through**

* Review dentist-approved treatment plans with patients, explaining proposed appointments, fees, estimated insurance benefits (if applicable), and expected patient responsibility in understandable terms.
* Reinforce information provided by the clinical team and refer questions about diagnosis, necessity, risks, alternatives, or prognosis to the treating clinician.
* Discuss financial concerns respectfully, explain approved payment and financing options, and assist with applications without promising approval.
* Schedule recommended care in the sequence and appointment lengths directed by the clinical team; coordinate referrals when needed.
* Maintain an organized follow-up list for unscheduled treatment, pending financial arrangements, and patients who need additional information; document contacts and outcomes.
* Support informed patient decisions without pressure, guarantees of clinical results, or representations that insurance estimates are guaranteed.

**Patient experience and communication**

* Welcome patients warmly, manage check-in and checkout, and create a professional, organized front office.
* Respond promptly to calls, texts, emails, and new patient inquiries; document conversations and follow through on next steps.
* Coordinate onboarding, digital forms, confirmations, and appointment preparation; identify missing information before visits.
* Listen to patient concerns, resolve routine service issues, and escalate clinical questions, complaints, or exceptions appropriately.

**Scheduling and financial administration**

* Manage the dentist and hygiene schedules using approved appointment templates, treatment priorities, and provider availability.
* Monitor cancellations, openings, and waitlists; offer appropriate appointments and coordinate changes with the clinical team.
* Coordinate recall and reactivation outreach to help established patients maintain ongoing care.
* Prepare written financial estimates and agreements, communicate payment expectations before appointments, and collect required payment before treatment in accordance with practice policy.
* Process payments accurately, issue receipts, post transactions, and reconcile daily collections with practice records.
* Review patient balances, follow up on amounts due, and escalate disputed charges, refunds, discounts, or adjustments for authorization.
* Verify insurance eligibility and available benefits before visits; obtain necessary information and clearly distinguish estimates from confirmed payments.
* Support claim preparation, submission, tracking, and follow-up as assigned; coordinate unresolved insurance issues with the designated billing lead or practice leadership.

**Office systems and team coordination**

* Maintain accurate patient demographics, communication notes, financial records, and administrative documentation in the practice management system.
* Learn and use Practice Management Software and other approved tools for scheduling, communication, insurance workflows, and patient payments.
* Participate in daily team huddles, flag scheduling or financial concerns, and provide clear handoffs between the front office and clinical team.
* Protect confidential patient and financial information and follow practice privacy, security, and HIPAA procedures.
* Monitor assigned office supplies and reorder within approved budgets and purchasing authority.
* Identify recurring workflow problems, recommend practical improvements, and maintain checklists that make daily work more reliable.
* Support related front office duties as practice needs evolve, with priorities set by leadership.

**Who will succeed here**

You are warm with patients and precise with details. You can discuss money calmly, manage competing priorities, and close the loop on commitments. You ask thoughtful questions, learn unfamiliar systems, and take initiative while recognizing when a decision requires clinical or leadership approval.

* Exceptional patient service and professional verbal and written communication.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, accurate data entry, and comfort working with numbers.
* Resourcefulness, sound judgment, problem-solving, and consistent follow-through.
* Ability to discuss treatment costs and payment expectations with empathy and confidence.
* Dependability, accountability, coachability, and a collaborative approach.
* Comfort with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and learning new software.

**Our culture and how to apply**

We value kindness, professionalism, curiosity, and accountability. We want someone who takes pride in helping patients and enjoys contributing to a growing practice. In return, we offer a collaborative environment, opportunities to learn, and a meaningful role in how our practice serves its community.

Please submit your resume and a brief introduction describing your relevant experience, your comfort discussing treatment costs and payments, and why this role interests you.

Overhill Dental is an equal opportunity employer. Reasonable accommodations are available during the hiring process and for essential job responsibilities.

Pay: $26.00 - $29.00 per hour

Expected hours: 24.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching

Experience:

As the largest Muslim civil rights and advocacy organization in California, we protect constitutional rights, advance justice, and empower communities through legal advocacy, public policy, civic engagement, and education.

Since 1994, that work has been made possible by a dedicated team committed to serving individuals, families, and communities across California. Behind every case, campaign, and initiative are people working together to create meaningful change.

**About Us**

OMI Specialty Products is a leading aerospace supplier with a proud history dating back to 1968. We provide aerospace parts, hardware, chemicals, and raw materials to OEMs, MROs, airlines, and their suppliers in both civil and defense applications, serving customers around the world. Our commitment to excellence, responsiveness, and integrity has made us a trusted partner across the industry.

**The Role**

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented Account Manager to join our inside sales team. You will own a book of customer accounts — turning RFQs into competitive quotes, sourcing parts from suppliers, and making sure every order ships complete and on time. This is a fast-paced, high-volume role for someone who likes solving problems, works well with a team, and wants to grow a career in aerospace sales.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Quote fast and accurately:** Respond to customer RFQs with competitive, accurate quotes in our ERP system, typically within the same business day.

* **Own the order:** Work with procurement, expediting, quality, and shipping to keep orders on track; resolve issues such as rejections, shortages, lead-time changes, and returns.
* **Get the paperwork right:** Ensure orders meet customer and aerospace quality requirements, including traceability, certifications, and documentation.
* **Stay compliant:** Follow OMI’s export-compliance procedures (ITAR/EAR), including customer and end-use screening.
* **Keep data clean:** Maintain accurate customer, quote, and order records in the ERP.

**What You Bring**

* Minimum 3-5 years of sales, account management, or customer service experience in the aerospace distribution industry, or a bachelor’s degree in business or a related field with a strong interest in aerospace sales.

**What We Offer**

* Base salary plus performance bonus
* Career growth in a growing, global company

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance (including family coverage)

Headquartered in **Long Beach, California**, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America's next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast is looking for a **People Operations Associate**, reporting to the **Senior Manager, People Operations**, to support the development of the systems that will be required for the design and build of human-rated space stations. This role ensures accurate, compliant employee data and documentation throughout the employee lifecycle, with a focus on HRIS data management, separations, and Workers' Compensation, while supporting international workforce operations, process improvement, and reporting.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, exercises sound judgment, and thrives in a fast-paced environment. At more senior levels, they operate independently, manage complex issues, identify risks, and drive scalable, compliant People Operations processes.

This will be a **full-time, exempt** position located in our **Long Beach** location.

**Responsibilities:**

**HRIS Data Integrity & Change Management — 30%**

* Manage employee data and HRIS changes in Rippling, ensuring accuracy, documentation, and appropriate approvals
* Partner with the HRIS Associate to support workflows, reporting, system testing, and issue resolution
* Conduct regular data audits, resolve discrepancies, and partner cross-functionally to maintain accurate and compliant employee records

**Separations, Termination Documentation & Offboarding — 25%**

* Manage employee separations and terminations, ensuring timely completion of documentation, system updates, stakeholder coordination, and final pay requirements
* Own the Separation Agreement process, including preparation, approvals, signature tracking, deadlines, and record-keeping
* Partner with People Business Partners, Legal, and Payroll to ensure separation documentation and off-boarding actions are accurate and compliant
* Escalate complex or high-risk separation matters as appropriate

**Workers' Compensation — 25%**

* Manage Workers' Compensation claims from injury reporting through return-to-work and claim closure
* File claims and provide required employee notices and documentation within applicable deadlines
* Serve as the primary People Operations contact for employees, managers, insurance carriers, EHS, and other stakeholders throughout the claims process
* Coordinate return-to-work and modified-duty plans and maintain accurate, confidential, and audit-ready records
* Monitor claims, deadlines, and trends and identify potential risks or process improvements

**International Hiring & Workforce Support — 10%**

* Support international hiring and workforce administration, including employment documentation, contracts, onboarding, employee changes, and separations
* Partner with internal teams and external vendors to support international workforce requirements and compliance
* Maintain accurate global employee and contractor records in Rippling and flag potential compliance or operational risks

**Process Improvement — 5%**

* Identify and implement improvements across People Operations processes, including employee changes, offboarding, Workers' Compensation, international workforce administration, and compliance
* Develop and maintain SOPs and supporting documentation to improve consistency, scalability, and audit readiness

**Reporting & Cross-Functional Partnership — 5%**

* Partner with HRIS and cross-functional teams to provide operational metrics, compliance reporting, and audit support
* Identify trends, gaps, and risks and provide actionable insights to People Operations leadership
* Collaborate with People Business Partners, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, Finance, IT, Legal, EHS, and other teams to resolve operational issues and support People initiatives

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma
* 3+ years of progressive experience in People Operations, HR Operations, HR Administration, or a related function. Candidates considered for the Senior People Operations Associate level should demonstrate deeper functional expertise, experience independently managing complex or sensitive employee matters, and a track record of improving or scaling People Operations processes
* Hands-on experience managing employee data and employee actions in an HRIS; Rippling strongly preferred. This role requires an expert HRIS user, not a system administrator
* Experience managing employee separations and termination documentation, including coordinating time-sensitive documentation, offboarding actions, and cross-functional requirements
* Experience managing Workers' Compensation claims, including intake, carrier coordination, claim administration, and return-to-work processes
* Experience supporting international hiring or workforce administration, including employment documentation and emp

jobs.description:
***About Tilray Brands, Inc.***

***Tilray Brands, Inc.*** (“Tilray”) (Nasdaq: TLRY; TSX: TLRY), is leading global lifestyle and consumer packaged goods company with operations in Canada, the United States, Europe, Australia, and Latin America that is leading as a transformative force at the nexus of cannabis, beverage, wellness, and entertainment, elevating lives through moments of connection. Tilray’s mission is to be a leading premium lifestyle company with a house of brands and innovative products that inspire joy, wellness and create memorable experiences. Tilray’s unprecedented platform supports over 40 brands in over 20 countries, including comprehensive cannabis offerings, hemp-based foods, and craft beverages.

**Tilray Beer,** a division of Tilray Brands Inc., is seeking personable, reliable, organized, and driven lovers of the good life to increase sales of its beloved craft brews in several of its key markets. In this role you will be responsible for building strong relationships with our customers and forging indelible connections between brands and consumers by making our products available, visible, relevant, recommended, and perfectly enjoyed every time. Our ambition is to reinvigorate the craft beer sector, becoming the fastest growing craft beer suppliers in the U.S. To achieve this, we need the very best talent on our team. Feel inspired? Then this may be the opportunity for you. If you are a self-starter who knows how to work and play hard, and you have an unwavering passion for independent, craft beer; grab your kayak and hop in the river with us!

  

**Summary:** Drive market growth by working with our Distributors to actively manage annual business plans including volume, retail distribution and relevant, in-market events and promotions. Our Field Sales Representatives are focused on our off- and on-premise accounts and will represent our beverage alcohol portfolio including: SweetWater Brewing Company, Montauk Brewing Company, Alpine Beer Company, Green Flash Brewing Company, Shock Top, Blue Point Brewing Co., Breckenridge Brewery, 10 Barrel Brewing Co., Redhook Brewery, Widmer Brothers Brewing, Square Mile Cider Company and lastly Hiball, a no alcohol, clean energy seltzer made with zero sugar, zero calories, and organic caffeine.
  
  
**Duties:**

* Selling: Ability to identify volume driving opportunities and sell into distributors and retailers
* Analysis: Experience with tools like VIP, Encompass or other similar applications to identify sales trends and take action to drive the business forward.
* Relationship Building: Establish business relationships with Distributor Partners, Key Retailers and the Community-at-Large to drive growth in targeted off- and on-premise accounts
* Planning: Organization and extreme attention-to-detail are mandatory for success in this role. Build annual and trimester plans with continuous measurement against achieving agreed upon goals.
* Communication: Outstanding written and oral communication clearly defining expectations for all stakeholders
* Accountability: Consistent and active management of daily business to drive volume goals and manage budgets
* Execution: Work with Distributor Partners, Key Customers and National Accounts to ensure flawless execution of both on- and off-premise programs in Chain/Independent outlets
Quality: Fresh beer is paramount to our success, your role is to assist in monitoring inventory levels, oversee clean seasonal transitions and conduct periodic Quality Audits to ensure that our customers are drinking our product at its peak  

  

**Job Requirements:**

* A minimum of 2 years relevant sales experience at a Beverage Distributor or Brewery
* Utilization of VIP, Encompass or other sales analytical tools

Four out of five days will be spent in the field visiting accounts, with an expectation of 10–15 account visits per day.

The expected annual base salary range for this role is USD $55,000 - $70,000 annually. Please note that the actual offer will be determined based on your location, skills, experience, education, market benchmarks, and internal equity.

At Tilray Brands, we recognize the importance of comprehensive total rewards. We provide:

* PTO & Paid Personal Time Off

* 401K

* Medical, Dental, Vision and Supplemental Insurances

* Employee & Family Assistance Program

Growth and Internal Mobility Opportunities  

  
  

Tilray welcomes applications from all qualified individuals and is committed to employment equity and diversity in the workplace.

Accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment process. If you require accommodations for interviews or other meetings, please advise when submitting your application.

Please note that Tilray does not authorize, engage, or sponsor any consultants, agencies or organizations that seek certain personal or financial information from you (e.g. passwords, login ids, credit card information). jobs.title: Specialty Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Extraordinary Careers. Endless Possibilities.**

**With the nation’s largest home infusion provider, there is no limit to the growth of your career.**

Option Care Health, Inc. is the largest independent home and alternate site infusion services provider in the United States. With over 8,000 team members including 5,000 clinicians, we work compassionately to elevate standards of care for patients with acute and chronic conditions in all 50 states. Through our clinical leadership, expertise and national scale, Option Care Health is re-imagining the infusion care experience for patients, customers and team members.

Join a company that is taking action to develop an inclusive, respectful, engaging and rewarding culture for all team members. At Option Care Health your voice is heard, your work is valued, and you’re empowered to grow. Cultivating a team with a variety of talents, backgrounds and perspectives makes us stronger, innovative, and more impactful. Our organization requires extraordinary people to provide extraordinary care, so we are investing in a culture that attracts, hires and retains the best and brightest talent in healthcare.

**Job Description Summary:**

The Specialty Sales Representative will travel within their territory promoting Option Care Health's broad infusion capabilities and value messages across multiple specialties in physician offices within their market. In markets with Ambulatory Infusion Clinics, they will drive the demand to fill the clinics. This individual will build and execute on in person call plans with support from the company, fully utilize the CRM, and demonstrate a disciplined approach to building and growing their territory. They will partner with operations teammates to ensure updates, solutions, and high customer satisfaction levels are being provided to referral sources. This person will be adaptable as new therapies and call points are added.

**Job Description:**

**Job Responsibilities**

Identify, establish, and maintain relationships with targeted physician offices and referral sources to increase patient referrals to Option Care Health.

Deliver persuasive and strategic sales presentations to physicians, office staff, and other key stakeholders.

Partner with clinical and administrative staff (e.g., biologics coordinators) to promote Option Care Health’s infusion services.

Execute daily face-to-face sales calls, maintaining activity levels as outlined in the sales plan.

Document all sales activities and customer interactions in the company’s CRM system in a timely and accurate manner.

Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to ensure superior customer service and support patient onboarding.

**Required Education/Experience**

High School Diploma or equivalent.

2–5 years of experience in business-to-business or healthcare sales, with a proven ability to generate referrals and grow revenue.

Demonstrated success in the infusion center, specialty pharmacy, or related healthcare market.

Experience using a CRM to track sales activity and customer engagement.

Valid driver’s license and ability to travel within the territory 90% of the time.

**Basic Qualifications**

Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.

Ability to translate company strategy into persuasive messaging tailored to the provider audience.

Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and maintain long-term business relationships.

Self-motivated and goal-oriented, with a demonstrated history of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Customer-focused mindset with strong problem-solving and learning agility.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in healthcare, business, or a related field.

Prior experience in IV infusion therapy, specialty pharmacy, or biologic drug promotion is highly desirable.

Due to state pay transparency laws, the full range for the position is below:

Salary to be determined by the applicant's education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Pay Range is $96,933.05-$161,570.09

**Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance
* Paid Time off
* Bonding Time Off
* 401K Retirement Savings Plan with Company Match
* HSA Company Match
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Tuition Reimbursement
* myFlexPay
* Family Support
* Mental Health Services
* Company Paid Life Insurance
* Award/Recognition Programs

*Option Care Health subscribes to a policy of equal employment opportunity, making employment available without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, citizenship status according to the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status, or genetic information.*

jobs.title: Studio Site & Social Media Manager (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
The studio is hiring a **part-time Studio Site & Social Media Manager** with flexible hours, at **$22–$26/hour** plus overtime. The role has two equal halves: running the studio floor on shoot days, and running the studio’s social media.

On site, you’ll check productions in and wrap them out, keep the stage clean and stocked, and take care of clients while they shoot. Online, you’ll turn what happens here into content that brings filmmakers, photographers, musicians and brands through our doors. We want someone who loves this space and wants to help build a real community of creatives around the studio and its almost 11-year history.

Responsibilities

**1. Studio site management (core)**

* Open the studio and check in productions: walk them through the space, power, house rules and safety.
* Check house gear in and out (grip, electric, furniture, props) against each booking.
* Run check in and wrap out: note add ons and damage, missing items or overtime, confirm the space is restored, trash is out and close out the booking.
* Be the on-site point of contact while clients shoot: answer questions, solve problems, troubleshoot G&E basics.
* Light cleaning and reset between bookings: floors, touch-ups, green room and restrooms.
* Track inventory of gear, expendables and supplies; flag repairs and reorder needs.

**2. Social media and content (core)**

* Own the studio’s social channels: plan, shoot, edit and post content on a regular schedule.
* Capture behind-the-scenes photos and video on shoot days, with client permission.
* Train other staff to capture behind-the-scenes content.
* Grow followers and engagement, and showcase the studio to production companies, labels and agencies.
* Track what’s working and share simple monthly results.

**3. Community and growth**

* Log client contacts, bookings and follow-ups in HubSpot.
* Introduce production companies, music labels, and marketing and ad agencies to the studio.
* Help plan and host community events, meetups and screenings.

What we’re looking for

**Required**

* Proven social media skills: shooting and editing short-form video, posting consistently and growing an audience. Please share accounts you’ve run and metrics.
* Studio site management and/or film, commercial or photo production experience.
* Comfortable being the point person with clients: calm, friendly and solution-focused under pressure.
* Organized and detail-oriented with check-ins, inventory and paperwork.
* Able to lift 30 lbs.

**Preferred**

* Experience with a CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
* Comfortable with photo and video editing tools.
* Working knowledge of grip and electric: stands, flags, rigging basics, lighting, power distribution and set safety.

**Bonus points**

* An existing network of production companies, music labels, and marketing and advertising agencies.
* A genuine desire to help build a community of creatives around the studio.

Schedule and pay

* **Employment type:** Part-time, hourly, non-exempt (W-2)
* **Hours:** About 10–40 hours per week, depending on bookings
* **Shift length:** 4–13 hours, based on bookings
* **Pay:** $22–$26/hour (good-faith range, based on experience)
* **Overtime:** 1.5x after 8 hours a day or 40 a week; 2x after 12 hours a day
* **Location:** On site, Downtown LA (DTLA) area

This is a part-time role with flexible hours. Expect some early calls, late wraps and weekends.

How to apply

Send your resume to **siterepjob@gmail.com**. Include links to social accounts you’ve run (with metrics), a few lines on why this role interests you and the community you’d bring with you, and your general weekly availability.

The studio is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative and the California Fair Chance Act.

Pay: $22.00 - $26.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 10.0 per week

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Associate Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
### **Our Mission**

As humans, there are few things more exciting than meeting someone new. At Tinder, we’re inspired by the challenge of keeping the magic of human connection alive. With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2+ billion swipes per day, 20+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing.

We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more.

### **Our Values**

* **Take the Lead:** We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
* **Move Fast:** We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
* **Better Together:** We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
* **Real Talk:** We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same.
* **Safety First:** We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
* **Spark Fun:** We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.

We're looking for a chronically online Associate Social Media Manager who moves at the speed of social. You know what stops the scroll, what feels native vs. forced, and how to turn an idea into something people actually want to watch and share. If you live in the comment sections, follow reality TV drama like a sport, know what’s trending before it hits the mainstream, and get Virgo-level obsessed about data and content calendars, this is the role for you.

You'll support the Social Content Lead and Senior Social Director in managing the content calendar, creating and optimizing content across TikTok, Instagram, and emerging platforms, and owning day-to-day community management from the caption to the comment section.

### **Where You'll Work:**

This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration three times per week in Los Angeles, CA.

  

### **In This Role, You Will:**

***Support and create strategic content execution and social media campaigns***

* Build and manage day-to-day posting calendars
* Create and optimize social-first content for TikTok, Instagram and emerging platforms, including supporting with hands-on graphic design and video editing
* Support social campaign development, including research, briefs, and creative strategy
* Move a post from a raw idea to a published asset — including copywriting, asset creation, approvals, and scheduling
* Write engaging captions, Threads, and tweets
* Schedule, tag, and publish posts for content optimization and reporting

***Own community management***

* Reply to comments and direct messages in the brand's voice
* Monitor brand mentions and sentiment across platforms
* Foster fan relationships and surface earned moments
* Source and manage UGC opportunities across platforms
* Escalate sensitive comments, DMs, or sentiment shifts according to team guidelines
* Surface insights from comments, DMs, and cultural shifts
* Help the broader team understand what's actually resonating (or not)

***Track performance for insights-to-action***

* Pull analytics reports across platforms
* Track engagement, reach, and follower growth
* Apply insights to action — feed learnings back into the content daily

***Trend watching***

* Spot internet culture shifts, viral trends and formats, emerging platforms, and competitor moves
* Surface potential risks, controversies, and emerging narratives taking place on internet communities
* Identify up-and-coming creators and talent for owned social campaigns

### **Skills Required:**

* 2–4 years of hands-on social media marketing experience
* Strong understanding of scheduling and listening software (i.e. Dash Social)
* Ability to concept, shoot, design, edit, and publish thumb-stopping social content; video editing and graphic design experience required.
* Comfortable behind or in-front-of the camera
* Experience creating and executing content calendars
* Deep understanding of social-first storytelling, internet culture, platform trends, and short-form video content. Fluent in TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, including formats, trends, and what actually performs with Gen Z women
* Internet, culture, and Gen-Z fluent - knows the biggest trends, tv shows, creators, and cultural moments before they go viral
* Strong writer with a sense of humor. Experience writing engaging captions and comments; fluent in Gen Z, internet, entertainment, and pop culture across the different social platforms
* Proficient in graphic design and video editing software like CapCut, Figma, Canva, and Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere, Photoshop)
* Strong communication, organizational, and creative judgment skills, with a high-ownership, hands-on approach
* Comfort partnering cross-functionally with Design, PR, and Paid Media teams
* Comfort with trackers and spreadsheets (Google Sheets) for managing multiple campaigns in parallel
* Able to prioritize and move fast when timelines shift or something breaks last-minute
* Flexibility for occasional evenings, weekends, and local travel for events and shoots

jobs.title: Time Critical Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
The **Time Critical Logistics Coordinator** is responsible for facilitating domestic and international freight across air transportation modes. They are a key liaison between customers, carriers, customs authorities, and internal stakeholders to ensure freight moves efficiently, compliantly, and cost effectively from origin to destination. They are highly organized, detail oriented, and capable of managing multiple shipments and priorities in a fast-paced logistics environment. They play a critical role in delivering exceptional service while supporting operational excellence and customer satisfaction.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate domestic and international freight shipments across air transportation modes.

* Manage the end-to-end forwarding process from shipment initiation through final delivery.

* Own the complete shipment process in CargoWise, including data entry, pickup and delivery scheduling, AES entry, airline bookings, routing, operational milestone updates, and costing.

* Ensure all customers' SOP instructions are adhered to, and internal/company KPIs and guidelines are and met.

* Prepare, review, and process shipping documentation including bills of lading, commercial invoices, packing lists, airway bills, and other transportation documents.

* Communicate proactively with customers, carriers, customs brokers, steamship lines, airlines, trucking providers, and internal teams regarding shipment status and requirements.

* Track and monitor freight movements to ensure timely pickup, transit, customs clearance, and delivery.

* Support import and export compliance by maintaining accurate shipment records and ensuring adherence to applicable regulations and trade requirements.

* Coordinate customs clearance activities and work closely with customs brokers and government agencies as needed.

* Identify and resolve transportation delays, documentation discrepancies, customs holds, and other shipment-related issues.

* Provide customers with shipment updates, quotes, service options, and solutions to support their logistics needs.

* Maintain accurate data and shipment information within transportation management and operational systems.

* Assist with carrier selection, routing decisions, and cost-effective transportation solutions.

* Support continuous improvement efforts related to service levels, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure a seamless customer experience and successful shipment execution.

* All other duties as assigned to meet evolving business needs.

**Qualifications**

* Education: High school diploma or equivalent required; additional logistics, transportation, supply chain, or business coursework preferred.

* Certification/Licensure: No specific certification required; industry certifications related to freight forwarding, import/export, customs, or logistics are a plus.

* Experience: 2+ years of direct experience in freight forwarding required

* Specialized experience in import operations, customs brokerage, and international logistics preferred.

* Experience supporting air freight operations strongly preferred.

* Prior working experience with CargoWise TMS and similar cloud-based transportation management/logistics platforms preferred.

* Working knowledge of international shipping documentation, transportation processes, and import/export procedures.

* Ability to manage multiple shipments, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced operational environment.

* Strong communication and customer service skills with the ability to build relationships across customers, carriers, and internal stakeholders.

* Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and resolve shipment issues efficiently.

* Demonstrated discretion and confidentiality in handling and protecting sensitive information.

* Technical: Proficient with common office technologies, including Windows PCs, Microsoft O365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) and web conferencing (Teams, Zoom, Webex, etc.)

* Sales & Revenue Growth
* Strategic Thinking
* Communication Proficiency (Verbal & Written)
* Problem Solving / Decision Making
* Strong Sense of Ownership & Accountability
* Customer Service Excellence
* Financial Acumen (Margins, Pricing, Profitability)

* Indirect oversight of Project Managers and Junior Project Managers.
* Responsible for delegation and quality of work within assigned accounts.

* Employees are expected to be in the office during standard business hours each workday to support cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Production, and Project Management teams.
* This role does not offer flexible or remote work arrangements, as consistent in-person communication is essential to successful project execution and account management.
* May require extended hours or occasional weekend work to support client deadlines and production schedules.

**EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS PREFERRED**

* Demonstrated ability to manage both client relationships and project execution.
* Strong understanding of production workflows and estimating processes.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

**KEY ROLE CLARIFICATION**

* This is **not a pure sales role**.
* This is **not a pure project management role**.
* This is a **hybrid ownership role** responsible for:

  + Revenue growth
  + Project execution

jobs.title: Inside Sales - Aftermarket
jobs.description:
**IMI plc**

We are a global specialist engineering company that creates breakthrough solutions. We are curious and like to solve problems, partnering with our customers to solve the demands of today and prepare for the challenges of tomorrow. We embrace innovation and care about outcomes that are good for business, everyday life and making a better world – creating lasting impact for everyone.

We design, build and service highly engineered products in fluid and motion control applications. We focus on five market sectors: Industrial Automation, Process Automation, Climate Control, Life Science, and Transport.

Our partnership approach breaks through problems and reduces complexity. We don’t invent in isolation – we collaborate with our customers. We listen closely and we think differently, creating space for diverse minds to innovate. We are working together to make businesses safer, more sustainable and more productive.

  

**Role Overview**:

The Inside Sales Representative supports existing customer accounts within the critical valve manufacturing industry by providing quotations, processing orders, and serving as a primary point of contact for customers. This role works closely with customers, the outside sales team, and internal departments to ensure accurate and timely support of customer requirements.

Following an initial training and evaluation period, the Inside Sales Representative is expected to take ownership of an assigned territory of existing customer accounts. The position carries individual sales performance expectations in addition to responsibilities for accuracy, customer service, account management, and effective follow-through.

The candidate must be detail-oriented, customer-focused, able to manage multiple priorities, and capable of working with minimal supervision after training is completed but can also adapt to working and collaborating in a team environment. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills are essential for identifying customer needs, resolving issues, researching product information, and supporting accurate quotations and order processing.

  

**Work Environment**:

Lake Forrest, CA - Hybrid

* Occasional travel to local customer sites

  

**Key Responsibilities**:

* Prepare customer quotations using available pricing, product, and historical sales information.
* Process customer orders accurately and in accordance with established procedures.
* Communicate with customers through phone and email regarding quotations, orders, product information, and account-related needs.
* Coordinate with the outside sales team to support customer accounts and sales activities.
* Research cost history, engineering drawings, specifications, and product information required to quote and sell parts.
* Maintain accurate and complete records in Salesforce CRM system.
* Manage multiple customer requests, priorities, and deadlines while ensuring timely follow-through.
* Exercise sound judgment within assigned authority levels and seek guidance when appropriate.
* Develop and maintain knowledge of company products, systems, and procedures.
* Support ongoing customer satisfaction and account retention efforts within an assigned territory.

  

**Critical Competencies for Success**:

Required Qualifications:

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Strong customer service, verbal communication, and written communication skills.
* Accurate typing, data entry, and recordkeeping abilities.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and changing workloads.
* Demonstrated ability to learn new products, systems, and processes quickly.
* Ability to work with minimal supervision after training is completed but can also adapt to working and collaborating in a team environment
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Microsoft Excel.

  

Preferred Qualifications

* Two to four years of valve industry experience or similar flow control products.
* Experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Previous inside sales experience.
* Experience using Salesforce CRM.
* Experience using IFS ERP.
* Completion of customer service certifications and/or formal sales training.

**Schedule and Work Arrangement**

Work Schedule

Typical work hours are 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

  

Training and Evaluation Period

Employees are expected to work in the office five days per week for at least the first 30 days for training and evaluation purposes.  
Additional onsite training or evaluation requirements beyond the initial 30 days may be required based on business needs and individual progress.

  

Hybrid Work Arrangement

After successful completion of the initial onsite training period, employees may be eligible for a hybrid work arrangement consisting of three days per week in the office and two days per week working remotely.

  

**Pay range**: $85,000 - $105,000 annually

Within this range, individual pay is determined based on skills, experience, and qualifications relative to the job requirements. Base pay information is aligned with market location and may be subject to prevailing wage laws, if applicable.

**Bonus eligibility**: This position is also eligible for a variable incentive pay component, separate from base salary.

  

**What IMI Can Offer You**

At IMI, one of our top priorities is to create an inclusive culture of health. We strive to remove barriers to care (whether that be physical or financial) and in doing so, we offer choice for all your health and wellbeing needs.

See below for a general overview of our amazing perks and benefits:

* Multiple health plans to choose from: HMO, PPO, and High Deductible Health Plans with a low-cost share
* Best-in-class 401K plan with zero vesting and up to 6% contribution matching
* 14-week maternity leave at full pay (Adoption benefits are equivalent)
* 4-week paternity leave at full pay (Adoption benefits are equivalent)

* Answer incoming and make outgoing phone calls to flight crew, customers and office personnel
* Coordinate and schedule maintenance, training and currency flights/activities.
* Assign crew to trips in conjunction with Chief Pilot/Director of Operations
* Perform crew repositioning (airline tickets, etc.)
* Perform international arrangements which may include: customs, handling and over flight exemptions
* Coordinate with crew to plan efficient technical stops, customs clearances and aircraft logistics (de-icing, hangar rentals, etc.)

* Verify with Flight Operations to ensure that all appropriate Company and regulatory requirements are met for each flight before trip authorization. Ensure the safety and legality of each flight
* Ensure required trip sheets and all other required trip documents are sent to and received by the appropriate crewmembers
* Ensure all required customs, immigration, international handling requirements, or foreign government regulations and requirements are met for every flight segment
* Responsible for the accurate and timely flight following for the fleet and any supplier providing lift and the efficient dissemination of such information to all Internal and External Customers to include but not limited to: Charter, Logistics, Maintenance, Accounting and all other interested parties
* Responsible for obtaining, monitoring, tracking, and disseminating any operational restriction to daily operations including, but not limited to: NOTAMs, TFRs, noise restrictions, FBO hours of operation, and airport capabilities

* Coordinate daily schedule to ensure each flight segment meets all company and FAR requirements including but not limited to: crew currency, crew qualifications, crew duty requirements, aircraft airworthiness, and that all-weather requirements are met

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Pendulum**

Pendulum® is leading a revolution that is occurring around the world to improve physical and mental health by first understanding, then restoring and enhancing the human microbiome.

Studies have shown that our microbiome (the bacterial communities in and on our bodies) is linked to everything from metabolism and diabetes, to longevity, weight loss, healthy immune systems, cancer prevention, feelings of well-being, inflammatory bowel disease, and even healthy skin. We have just scratched the surface on understanding the impact that our microbiome has on our lives. During early life we develop a diverse and balanced microbiome that plays a critical role in shaping our long-term health. Over our lives, a combination of diet, lifestyle, antibiotics, and aging can decrease the effectiveness of our microbiome.

Pendulum recognized the enormous impact they could have on people’s lives if they were able to address the imbalances in the microbiome. To accomplish this, Pendulum created proprietary probiotic pipelines and a unique discovery platform to identify key, novel bacterial strains and the prebiotics that feed them. The company has also built and developed the world’s first manufacturing technology to produce bacteria in an anaerobic (oxygen-free) environment at scale.

The medical probiotics that Pendulum has formulated have transformed the consumer probiotics market into a new category of therapeutic offerings that deliver the power and efficacy of a pharmaceutical with the safety and accessibility of a natural probiotic. Due to Pendulum’s explosive revenue and customer growth over the last two years, the company earned a spot on Forbes Magazine’s exclusive “The Next Billion Dollar Startups” list.

If you’re interested in improving the lives of people globally and you love working in a cross-functional, collaborative, inspiring environment, please continue reading.

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for an organized, proactive Project Coordinator to join our Product team. You'll work closely with the Program Manager to keep projects moving, supporting Supply Chain and other cross-functional initiatives such as supplier onboarding, packaging changes and new product launches. You'll be the person who keeps the details in order: agendas drafted, files organized, deliverables tracked, and issues flagged early.

We’re looking for someone who’s energized by the pace and possibility of a fast-growing, mission-driven company. You thrive in a collaborative, nimble environment where ideas are shaped through iteration, feedback, and shared vision. You’re not just a big thinker—you’re also a creative problem-solver who knows how to make things happen with limited resources. If you're excited by the opportunity to help shape a young brand from the ground up, and passionate about building something with purpose, you'll feel right at home here.

### **What You'll Do**

* Support day-to-day coordination and management of Supply Chain and other cross-functional projects, including supplier onboarding, packaging changes and new product launches
* Draft meeting agendas, capture notes and action items, and distribute follow-ups
* Monitor daily progress on project deliverables and flag risks, delays, or blockers to the Program Manager
* Maintain project documentation, keeping files, trackers, and shared folders organized, current, and easy to find
* Update project plans, timelines, and status reports
* Schedule meetings and coordinate availability across internal teams and external partners
* Work cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Regulatory, Quality, Finance, Product, and Marketing
* Serve as the main point of contact between team members and the Program Manager.
* Draft and update SOPs and checklists as workflows change
* Help run project kickoffs and retrospectives, and capture lessons learned
* Help identify opportunities to improve project processes and templates.

### **What You’ll Need**

**Experience**

* 1-3 years of experience in project management in operations, supply chain, procurement or a similar role
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
* Comfort working with data in spreadsheets (sorting, filtering, formulas, lookups)
* Proficiency with Google Workspace

**Skills**

* Organization: Multitasking and managing daily details across multiple workflows
* Communication: Clear verbal and written updates for stakeholders and teams
* Time Management: Keeping fast-moving tasks aligned with deadlines
* Technical Proficiency: Using scheduling frameworks (like Gantt charts), spreadsheets, and project management tools

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting product launches or supplier/vendor onboarding
* Exposure to supply chain, procurement, or consumer products
* Familiarity with ERP or inventory systems (such as NetSuite) or purchase order workflows

### **Salary & Benefits**

* $72,000-$85,000
* Medical, Dental, and Vision
* Commuter Benefits
* Life & STD Insurance
* Company match on 401 (k)
* Flexible Time Off (FTO)
* Equity

**About the Office**  
The Office of Professional Competence (OPC) helps California attorneys practice law ethically. OPC develops and maintains resources that facilitate compliance with ethical duties. The office administers the MCLE program and a telephone call center called the Ethics Hotline, and conducts preventative education and outreach. The office also supports key committees and working groups that provide ethics guidance and address policy and rule changes, certifies Lawyer Referral Services, and oversees the support side of the Lawyer Assistance Program.

**About Plasmidsaurus**

Plasmidsaurus is on a mission to accelerate new cures and promote a healthier planet by unlocking a new level of productivity for scientists. Our sequencing services are used daily by thousands of innovators, including Nobel laureates, Fortune 100 pharma, and over 70,000 scientists.

We began by revolutionizing plasmid sequencing, making it exponentially cheaper and faster, with innovative sequencing technologies and a global network of laboratories that turn samples into answers in hours, not weeks.

Now we are expanding that same disruptive model across all of genomics. With the launch of our new RNA-seq service, we are taking a bold step toward our vision to sequence everything, providing scientists everywhere with faster, simpler, and more affordable access to the data that powers discovery.

Every team member at Plasmidsaurus plays a crucial role in driving the future of biotech research. Together, we are building the world’s most efficient sequencing engine that operates overnight, scales globally, and helps scientists make breakthroughs faster than ever before.

**Role Overview**
=================

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Merch, Events, and Brand Experience, you'll scale the in-person presence that puts our sequencing services directly in front of the scientists who use them every day. You'll own execution across our field marketing calendar, including major scientific conferences, sales account-based events, and a new North American roadshow program, turning each one into an on-brand touchpoint that builds pipeline and deepens trust with our scientific community.

This is a hands-on role for someone who's as comfortable packing a booth crate and running a load-in as they are building a run-of-show or briefing a booth team. We build our own booths and don't rely on external events agencies. Within your first year, you'll run a major conference on your own and build programs that don't exist yet.

Based in South San Francisco, 3 days a week in the office.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Tradeshow & Conference Execution**

* Plan and execute our tradeshow calendar of major scientific conferences and society meetings, such as ASHG, AACR, PAG, and ASM
* Design and build our booths, from layout to on-site setup
* Own booth logistics, shipping, signage, staffing schedules, and lead capture across single-booth, double-booth, and international formats
* Brief and direct booth teams of about 10, including scientists and executives, on messaging, demos, and goals
* Coordinate show organizers, general contractors, AV, and catering directly, on time and on budget
* Serve as event project manager before each show, coordinating across Marketing, Sales, Product, R&D, and leadership
* Take conferences on your own when the calendar overlaps

### **Field Marketing & Sales Events**

* Develop, plan, and execute field marketing programs: sales account-based events, roadshows, and regional user meetings
* Design and build a North American roadshow program from scratch
* Take sales-led events beyond today's playbook, raising the brand bar at each one
* Coordinate logistics from venue sourcing through teardown
* Align events with Sales account priorities and pipeline goals, and own lead handoff and follow-up
* Build a multi-channel outreach and promotional plan for each event
* Work with the social media team on event content, including attendee sharing

### **Operations & Reporting**

* Own budgets, vendor and venue coordination, contracts, timelines, and shipping
* Track leads, cost per lead, and attendee feedback, and use them to improve future events
* Help build and maintain the field marketing calendar and budget tracker, flagging risks early

### **Brand & On-Site Staffing**

* Work with Brand and Design so booths, signage, and collateral reflect our brand and voice
* Travel to events, including evenings and weekends around show dates, to lead setup, staffing, and teardown

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

### **The First Three Months**

You've worked our January conferences, including the prep, and know how our booth comes together. You’ve learned the process of running a conference from prep to execution to measurement and debrief, the Plasmidsaurus way.

### **Within Six Months**

You've worked four major conferences across single-booth, double-booth, and international formats and are ready to lead one. Booth teams, including senior staff, follow your direction with confidence.

### **Within One Year**

You've run a major conference on your own and supported every show on our calendar. Sales-led events get hands-on support and are as on-brand as our conferences. A North American roadshow program is designed and piloted, and every event feeds measurable pipeline. You're a right hand and thought partner to the team.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 3–5 years in field marketing, event marketing, or trade show and conference coordination
* Startup or scale-up experience strongly preferred; life science, genomics, or biotech background a plus
* Conference booth experience end to end preferred; retail pop-ups or brand activations also count
* Experience with field programs beyond the show floor (roadshows, user meetings, regional sales events) a plus
* End-to-end event logistics: shipping, show-site services, general contractors, AV, catering, and venue sourcing
* Budget tracking and vendor management, including contracts
* Lead capture, scoring, and handoff with Sales using Salesforce and HubSpot; Popl and Luma a plus
* Run-of-show, staffing schedules, and booth-team briefings
* Proficiency in Google Workspace
* Comfortable with hands-on booth builds with no install crew, including lifting 15+ lb boxes
* Experience working with large teams and senior leadership

**Ways of Working**
-------------------

**Build.** Creative and scrappy, you find ways to stand out against much larger competitors. You build program

jobs.description:
PERSONAL & BUSINESS OPERATIONS ASSISTANT

WCI Electric – Santa Clara, CA  
Part-Time or Full-Time | 20–40 Hours Per Week  
$30–$40 Per Hour, Based on Experience

ABOUT THE POSITION

WCI Electric is a small, family-owned electrical contracting company serving the Silicon Valley area. We are currently owner-operated and looking for a dependable, highly organized person who can become the owner’s right hand by helping manage both business operations and personal responsibilities.

This is not a traditional receptionist position. The right person will help bring organization, follow-through and structure to a busy electrical contracting business while also assisting with personal scheduling, household coordination and occasional errands.

The position can range from 20 to 40 hours per week depending on the candidate’s experience, capabilities and availability. For the right person, this has the potential to develop into a long-term operations-management position as the company grows.

BUSINESS RESPONSIBILITIES

* Manage and prioritize email, phone messages and daily follow-ups
* Schedule service calls, site visits and customer appointments
* Communicate with customers regarding scheduling and project status
* Organize information needed for estimates and invoices
* Follow up on outstanding estimates, invoices and customer approvals
* Assist with QuickBooks Online data entry and administrative tasks
* Coordinate permits, material orders, deliveries and vendor paperwork
* Track project documents, change orders, deposits and closeout items
* Organize hiring applications and schedule candidate interviews
* Assist with customer review requests and business-development outreach
* Maintain an organized list of tasks requiring the owner’s attention
* Help develop simple systems that prevent important items from being overlooked

PERSONAL AND HOUSEHOLD RESPONSIBILITIES

* Manage personal appointments, reminders and calendar items
* Coordinate household repairs, service providers and organizing projects
* Obtain and compare vendor quotes
* Handle returns, purchases and occasional local errands
* Assist with vehicle service, property maintenance and travel planning
* Organize personal documents and ongoing projects
* Help keep the owner’s business and personal priorities organized

This is not a housekeeping, childcare or caregiving position.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

* Exceptionally organized, dependable and trustworthy
* Comfortable working directly with a busy small-business owner
* Able to take loosely explained information and turn it into a clear action plan
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Professional and comfortable communicating with customers, contractors and vendors
* Able to work independently and follow assignments through to completion
* Discreet with confidential business and personal information
* Comfortable adjusting priorities when urgent issues arise
* Proficient with email, calendars, Microsoft Office and basic online systems
* Experience with QuickBooks Online, construction administration, project coordination, property management or executive assistance is helpful but not required

The ideal candidate may have previous experience as an executive assistant, personal assistant, office manager, project coordinator, property-management coordinator or small-business administrator.

SCHEDULE AND LOCATION

* Flexible schedule of approximately 20–40 hours per week
* Part-time or full-time opportunity for the right candidate
* Primarily in person in Santa Clara
* Consistent weekday schedule to be agreed upon
* Some flexibility may be available after the position is established
* Occasional local errands or vendor visits
* Reliable transportation and a valid driver’s license are required
* Approved mileage for work-related errands will be reimbursed

COMPENSATION

$30–$40 per hour, depending on experience, availability and demonstrated ability.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

The successful person will reduce the number of unfinished tasks, keep customers and vendors informed, ensure important follow-ups happen and help the owner remain focused on electrical work, estimating and company growth.

This position has the potential to become an important long-term role within WCI Electric.

HOW TO APPLY

Please submit your résumé along with a brief response to the following:

* Describe a position where you managed professional and personal responsibilities for an owner, executive or small business.
* How do you keep track of multiple assignments and ensure nothing gets forgotten?
* Are you available to work primarily in person in Santa Clara for between 20 and 40 hours per week?
* How many hours per week would you ideally like to work?
* What hourly compensation are you seeking?
* Please provide an example of a disorganized situation that you helped bring under control.

Qualified candidates will begin with a brief phone conversation followed by an in-person interview and a paid working evaluation.
