The Social Media Manager is a hands-on member of the 9Rooftops Strategy team responsible for supporting the day-to-day execution of social media across a portfolio of client brands. The Social Media Manager ensures content is scheduled and published on time, performance is accurately tracked and reported, communities are actively managed, and influencer programs stay organized. This role works closely with social strategists, digital project managers and account teams, and provides the operational foundation that allows great social strategy to come to life in an agency environment.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Content & Publishing**

* Schedule and publish social content across platforms using approved content calendars and publishing tools.
* Ensure posts are accurately programmed, including copy, creative, tagging, links and publishing dates/times.
* Ensure content aligns with all defined best practices and has been proofed and approved before it is posted.
* Help maintain content calendars.
* Flag potential issues, missed deadlines or content needs to the appropriate team members.

**Analytics & Reporting**

* Gather and organize monthly social performance metrics across platforms.
* Build recurring client reports and presentations using established templates.
* Ensure reporting is accurate, timely and clearly organized.
* In partnership with the team, help identify notable trends, top-performing content and opportunities for optimization.
* Maintain reporting trackers and historical performance data.

**Influencer Support**

* Support the Senior Social Media Influencer + Strategist with tasks including:
  + Research and identify potential creators based on audience, content, brand fit and campaign needs.
  + Help coordinate communication and follow-ups with creators and partners.
  + Keep influencer projects organized from initial outreach through completion.
  + Track contracts, deliverables, invoices and payments as needed.

**Community Management**

* On behalf of a select number of 9Rooftops clients:
  + Monitor comments, direct messages and other social inquiries.
  + Respond to routine questions and comments in the brand's established voice, using the approved response matrix.
  + Escalate customer service issues, sensitive topics or questions requiring client expertise.
  + Maintain a timely and thoughtful presence across assigned social channels.

**Team & Strategy Support**

* Support the team with research, competitive reviews, trend tracking and other social intelligence as needed.
* Stay current on platform updates, emerging formats, creators, trends and cultural conversations.
* Help with administrative and organizational tasks that keep the team running efficiently.
* Enter time on a daily basis.
* Take on other projects and responsibilities as needed.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 0-3 years of experience in social media, marketing, communications, advertising or a related field; internships and relevant academic or personal experience are welcome (e.g., freelance work with existing small businesses).
* Strong interest in social media, digital culture and how brands show up online.
* Basic understanding of major social platforms, including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.
* Familiarity with social publishing or analytics platforms is a plus, but not required.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, presentations and recurring processes, or willing to learn.
* Strong written communication skills and good judgment.
* Able to manage multiple deadlines and priorities.
* Curious, proactive and willing to ask questions.
* Comfortable working collaboratively.
* Ability to follow all standard agency policies and procedures.

**What Will Make You Successful**

* Attention to detail: a broken link, incorrect tag or missed post doesn't get past you.
* Keeps things moving: you don't wait until someone asks for an update; you know what needs to happen next.
* Curious about the “why”: you're not just pulling numbers or scheduling posts; you want to understand what the data means and why the content is being put into the world.
* Plugged in: you naturally notice what's trending, what people are talking about and how brands are behaving on social.
* Good teammate: you communicate clearly, ask for help when you need it and make the people around you more effective.

The base salary for this position is $65,000, with the potential for up to an additional 20% if the applicant hired has additional related qualifications. Eastport Holdings offers a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life and disability coverage, HSA employer contributions, flexible spending accounts, employee assistance resources, paid time off, paid parental leave, and voluntary benefits designed to support your overall well-being.

**With the nation’s largest home infusion provider, there is no limit to the growth of your career.**

Option Care Health, Inc. is the largest independent home and alternate site infusion services provider in the United States. With over 8,000 team members including 5,000 clinicians, we work compassionately to elevate standards of care for patients with acute and chronic conditions in all 50 states. Through our clinical leadership, expertise and national scale, Option Care Health is re-imagining the infusion care experience for patients, customers and team members.

Join a company that is taking action to develop an inclusive, respectful, engaging and rewarding culture for all team members. At Option Care Health your voice is heard, your work is valued, and you’re empowered to grow. Cultivating a team with a variety of talents, backgrounds and perspectives makes us stronger, innovative, and more impactful. Our organization requires extraordinary people to provide extraordinary care, so we are investing in a culture that attracts, hires and retains the best and brightest talent in healthcare.

**Job Description Summary:**

The Specialty Sales Representative will travel within their territory promoting Option Care Health's broad infusion capabilities and value messages across multiple specialties in physician offices within their market. In markets with Ambulatory Infusion Clinics, they will drive the demand to fill the clinics. This individual will build and execute on in person call plans with support from the company, fully utilize the CRM, and demonstrate a disciplined approach to building and growing their territory. They will partner with operations teammates to ensure updates, solutions, and high customer satisfaction levels are being provided to referral sources. This person will be adaptable as new therapies and call points are added.

**Job Description:**

**Job Responsibilities**

Identify, establish, and maintain relationships with targeted physician offices and referral sources to increase patient referrals to Option Care Health.

Deliver persuasive and strategic sales presentations to physicians, office staff, and other key stakeholders.

Partner with clinical and administrative staff (e.g., biologics coordinators) to promote Option Care Health’s infusion services.

Execute daily face-to-face sales calls, maintaining activity levels as outlined in the sales plan.

Document all sales activities and customer interactions in the company’s CRM system in a timely and accurate manner.

Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to ensure superior customer service and support patient onboarding.

**Required Education/Experience**

High School Diploma or equivalent.

2–5 years of experience in business-to-business or healthcare sales, with a proven ability to generate referrals and grow revenue.

Demonstrated success in the infusion center, specialty pharmacy, or related healthcare market.

Experience using a CRM to track sales activity and customer engagement.

Valid driver’s license and ability to travel within the territory 90% of the time.

**Basic Qualifications**

Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.

Ability to translate company strategy into persuasive messaging tailored to the provider audience.

Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and maintain long-term business relationships.

Self-motivated and goal-oriented, with a demonstrated history of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Customer-focused mindset with strong problem-solving and learning agility.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in healthcare, business, or a related field.

Prior experience in IV infusion therapy, specialty pharmacy, or biologic drug promotion is highly desirable.

Due to state pay transparency laws, the full range for the position is below:

Salary to be determined by the applicant's education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Pay Range is $96,933.05-$161,570.09

* Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance
* Paid Time off

* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Tuition Reimbursement
* myFlexPay
* Family Support

new_jobs.title: Studio Site & Social Media Manager (Part-Time)
new_jobs.description:
The studio is hiring a **part-time Studio Site & Social Media Manager** with flexible hours, at **$22–$26/hour** plus overtime. The role has two equal halves: running the studio floor on shoot days, and running the studio’s social media.

On site, you’ll check productions in and wrap them out, keep the stage clean and stocked, and take care of clients while they shoot. Online, you’ll turn what happens here into content that brings filmmakers, photographers, musicians and brands through our doors. We want someone who loves this space and wants to help build a real community of creatives around the studio and its almost 11-year history.

Responsibilities

**1. Studio site management (core)**

* Open the studio and check in productions: walk them through the space, power, house rules and safety.
* Check house gear in and out (grip, electric, furniture, props) against each booking.
* Run check in and wrap out: note add ons and damage, missing items or overtime, confirm the space is restored, trash is out and close out the booking.
* Be the on-site point of contact while clients shoot: answer questions, solve problems, troubleshoot G&E basics.
* Light cleaning and reset between bookings: floors, touch-ups, green room and restrooms.
* Track inventory of gear, expendables and supplies; flag repairs and reorder needs.

**2. Social media and content (core)**

* Own the studio’s social channels: plan, shoot, edit and post content on a regular schedule.
* Capture behind-the-scenes photos and video on shoot days, with client permission.
* Train other staff to capture behind-the-scenes content.
* Grow followers and engagement, and showcase the studio to production companies, labels and agencies.
* Track what’s working and share simple monthly results.

**3. Community and growth**

* Log client contacts, bookings and follow-ups in HubSpot.
* Introduce production companies, music labels, and marketing and ad agencies to the studio.
* Help plan and host community events, meetups and screenings.

What we’re looking for

**Required**

* Proven social media skills: shooting and editing short-form video, posting consistently and growing an audience. Please share accounts you’ve run and metrics.
* Studio site management and/or film, commercial or photo production experience.
* Comfortable being the point person with clients: calm, friendly and solution-focused under pressure.
* Organized and detail-oriented with check-ins, inventory and paperwork.
* Able to lift 30 lbs.

**Preferred**

* Experience with a CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
* Comfortable with photo and video editing tools.
* Working knowledge of grip and electric: stands, flags, rigging basics, lighting, power distribution and set safety.

**Bonus points**

* An existing network of production companies, music labels, and marketing and advertising agencies.
* A genuine desire to help build a community of creatives around the studio.

Schedule and pay

* **Employment type:** Part-time, hourly, non-exempt (W-2)
* **Hours:** About 10–40 hours per week, depending on bookings
* **Shift length:** 4–13 hours, based on bookings
* **Pay:** $22–$26/hour (good-faith range, based on experience)
* **Overtime:** 1.5x after 8 hours a day or 40 a week; 2x after 12 hours a day
* **Location:** On site, Downtown LA (DTLA) area

This is a part-time role with flexible hours. Expect some early calls, late wraps and weekends.

How to apply

Send your resume to **siterepjob@gmail.com**. Include links to social accounts you’ve run (with metrics), a few lines on why this role interests you and the community you’d bring with you, and your general weekly availability.

The studio is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative and the California Fair Chance Act.

Pay: $22.00 - $26.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 10.0 per week

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.description:
**About Plasmidsaurus**

Plasmidsaurus is on a mission to accelerate new cures and promote a healthier planet by unlocking a new level of productivity for scientists. Our sequencing services are used daily by thousands of innovators, including Nobel laureates, Fortune 100 pharma, and over 70,000 scientists.

We began by revolutionizing plasmid sequencing, making it exponentially cheaper and faster, with innovative sequencing technologies and a global network of laboratories that turn samples into answers in hours, not weeks.

Now we are expanding that same disruptive model across all of genomics. With the launch of our new RNA-seq service, we are taking a bold step toward our vision to sequence everything, providing scientists everywhere with faster, simpler, and more affordable access to the data that powers discovery.

Every team member at Plasmidsaurus plays a crucial role in driving the future of biotech research. Together, we are building the world’s most efficient sequencing engine that operates overnight, scales globally, and helps scientists make breakthroughs faster than ever before.

**Role Overview**
=================

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Merch, Events, and Brand Experience, you'll scale the in-person presence that puts our sequencing services directly in front of the scientists who use them every day. You'll own execution across our field marketing calendar, including major scientific conferences, sales account-based events, and a new North American roadshow program, turning each one into an on-brand touchpoint that builds pipeline and deepens trust with our scientific community.

This is a hands-on role for someone who's as comfortable packing a booth crate and running a load-in as they are building a run-of-show or briefing a booth team. We build our own booths and don't rely on external events agencies. Within your first year, you'll run a major conference on your own and build programs that don't exist yet.

Based in South San Francisco, 3 days a week in the office.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Tradeshow & Conference Execution**

* Plan and execute our tradeshow calendar of major scientific conferences and society meetings, such as ASHG, AACR, PAG, and ASM
* Design and build our booths, from layout to on-site setup
* Own booth logistics, shipping, signage, staffing schedules, and lead capture across single-booth, double-booth, and international formats
* Brief and direct booth teams of about 10, including scientists and executives, on messaging, demos, and goals
* Coordinate show organizers, general contractors, AV, and catering directly, on time and on budget
* Serve as event project manager before each show, coordinating across Marketing, Sales, Product, R&D, and leadership
* Take conferences on your own when the calendar overlaps

### **Field Marketing & Sales Events**

* Develop, plan, and execute field marketing programs: sales account-based events, roadshows, and regional user meetings
* Design and build a North American roadshow program from scratch
* Take sales-led events beyond today's playbook, raising the brand bar at each one
* Coordinate logistics from venue sourcing through teardown
* Align events with Sales account priorities and pipeline goals, and own lead handoff and follow-up
* Build a multi-channel outreach and promotional plan for each event
* Work with the social media team on event content, including attendee sharing

### **Operations & Reporting**

* Own budgets, vendor and venue coordination, contracts, timelines, and shipping
* Track leads, cost per lead, and attendee feedback, and use them to improve future events
* Help build and maintain the field marketing calendar and budget tracker, flagging risks early

### **Brand & On-Site Staffing**

* Work with Brand and Design so booths, signage, and collateral reflect our brand and voice
* Travel to events, including evenings and weekends around show dates, to lead setup, staffing, and teardown

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

### **The First Three Months**

You've worked our January conferences, including the prep, and know how our booth comes together. You’ve learned the process of running a conference from prep to execution to measurement and debrief, the Plasmidsaurus way.

### **Within Six Months**

You've worked four major conferences across single-booth, double-booth, and international formats and are ready to lead one. Booth teams, including senior staff, follow your direction with confidence.

### **Within One Year**

You've run a major conference on your own and supported every show on our calendar. Sales-led events get hands-on support and are as on-brand as our conferences. A North American roadshow program is designed and piloted, and every event feeds measurable pipeline. You're a right hand and thought partner to the team.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 3–5 years in field marketing, event marketing, or trade show and conference coordination
* Startup or scale-up experience strongly preferred; life science, genomics, or biotech background a plus
* Conference booth experience end to end preferred; retail pop-ups or brand activations also count
* Experience with field programs beyond the show floor (roadshows, user meetings, regional sales events) a plus
* End-to-end event logistics: shipping, show-site services, general contractors, AV, catering, and venue sourcing
* Budget tracking and vendor management, including contracts
* Lead capture, scoring, and handoff with Sales using Salesforce and HubSpot; Popl and Luma a plus
* Run-of-show, staffing schedules, and booth-team briefings
* Proficiency in Google Workspace
* Comfortable with hands-on booth builds with no install crew, including lifting 15+ lb boxes
* Experience working with large teams and senior leadership

**Ways of Working**
-------------------

**Build.** Creative and scrappy, you find ways to stand out against much larger competitors. You build program

The Matter Compiler™ is aimed at micro-machines: motors and gears the size of a grain of sand, robots small enough to work inside the body, cooling built directly into the chips that run AI, and the many devices like them that have been waiting on a way to build them. Its first product is PrimeSwitch™, an electromechanical power relay the size of a button battery that carries 150 amps continuous current and opens in 50 microseconds, about a thousand times faster than a conventional contactor. We're looking for someone proactive, trustworthy, and hyper-organized who thrives in a fast-moving startup environment. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

### **What You'll Do:**

new_jobs.title: Account Manager – CDPAP Enrollment & Consumer Relations
new_jobs.description:
Excellent Facilitators is seeking a highly organized, motivated, and service-oriented Account Manager to guide prospective consumers through the process of becoming participants within New York's Consumer Directed Personal Assistance Program (CDPAP).

Once our Intake Department qualifies a prospective consumer and confirms their interest in moving forward, the Account Manager assumes responsibility for managing their experience from beginning to end.

As the consumer's primary point of contact, you'll coordinate each stage of the enrollment process, maintain consistent communication, address potential obstacles, and work closely with consumers, their families, healthcare organizations, and internal departments to facilitate a smooth onboarding into the program.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage a portfolio of qualified consumer referrals from initial assignment through successful CDPAP activation.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for consumers and their families throughout the enrollment process.
* Explain enrollment requirements, timelines, and next steps clearly and professionally.
* Coordinate Medicaid eligibility matters, health plan requirements, assessments, PPL registration, and personal assistant onboarding as applicable.
* Proactively follow up with consumers, families, healthcare partners, and other involved parties to keep each referral progressing.
* Identify and resolve enrollment delays, missing documentation, and other obstacles.
* Maintain accurate, detailed, and timely records of consumer interactions, enrollment milestones, and case statuses in company systems.
* Collaborate with internal departments and external partners to ensure a coordinated consumer experience.
* Take ownership of assigned referrals, prioritizing timely enrollment, consumer satisfaction, and successful program activation.

**What We're Looking For**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously.
* A proactive, persistent, and solutions-oriented approach to problem-solving.
* Exceptional follow-through and attention to detail.
* Ability to develop trusting relationships with consumers and their families.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with individual performance goals.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Minimum of 2 years of professional in-office experience
* Previous experience with CDPAP, Medicaid, managed long-term care (MLTC), or healthcare enrollment is helpful, but not required
* Strong interpersonal, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Comfortable working with CRM systems, tracking case progress, and maintaining accurate documentation.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams and external partners.
* Bilingual English/Spanish

**Compensation & Benefits**

Excellent Facilitators offers competitive hourly compensation and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees.

* **Hourly Pay:** $20.00 per hour.
* **Employment Type:** Full-time.
* **Schedule:** Monday through Friday.
* **Health Insurance:** Access to company-sponsored health insurance - modest employee contribution.
* **Paid Time Off (PTO):** Accrue 3+ weeks of paid time off annually, subject to company policy.

**Join Our Team**

If you're a proactive, detail-oriented professional who enjoys building relationships, solving problems, and helping individuals navigate important healthcare services, we'd love to hear from you.

Join Excellent Facilitators and become part of a team committed to providing exceptional support to New Yorkers and their families throughout their CDPAP journey.

Pay: From $20.00 per hour

Expected hours: 35.0 – 38.0 per week

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
Revivn is a profitable and rapidly growing company that helps enterprises manage their technology through our end of life software platform. We take electronic recycling one step further by repurposing hardware that still has remaining life and providing it to people who lack dedicated computer access and make it more affordable for people who may not be able to purchase new technology. Working with companies like Instacart, Lyft, Qualtrics, X, Gensler, and Spotify, we are changing the way companies view used technology with a new model that focuses on repurposing instead of recycling.

**Please note this role is based on-site at our Brooklyn Navy Yard office with Remote Wednesdays.**

Revivn is the rare combination sellers dream of: the learning and growth potential of a startup with the stability of a proven business. We've been profitable since our inception 14 years ago while revolutionizing how enterprise companies dispose of outdated IT equipment. Beyond recycling, we give hardware a second life and make technology accessible to those who need it most.

Now, we're looking for a strategic Enterprise SDR who wants to break into high-stakes enterprise sales, chasing down the most exciting logos in tech and setting the stage for big deals. This is a launchpad into an Account Executive career.

### **Why This Role Is Different**

You'll partner closely with Marketing and an experienced **Enterprise AE**, working to identify, engage, and break into high-value enterprise accounts. Think of this as your apprenticeship for enterprise sales where you'll learn to prospect with precision, strategy, and purpose, not volume.

We're looking for someone ambitious, competitive, and sharp. Someone who wants to earn it and is ready to put in the work to grow in their sales career.

**What You'll Do**

* Build thoughtful, personalized outreach across email, phone, LinkedIn, and in-person events that earn real conversations
* Partner closely with Marketing and the Enterprise AE on account research, org mapping, and entry strategies for target accounts
* Join early-stage sales calls with the CEO and Enterprise AE to learn enterprise discovery and start taking ownership of your own meetings over time
* Develop a strong understanding of Revivn's value proposition and tailor it to different stakeholders
* Continuously improve your prospecting, messaging, and sales skills through feedback and coaching

#### **We're looking for**

* 1–2 years of SDR/BDR experience in SaaS, enterprise, or B2B sales; **or** an ambitious recent grad eager to break into enterprise sales
* Someone hungry to grow into an Account Executive role within 12–18 months
* A strategic thinker who can adapt outreach for complex buying committees — not just blast templates
* Highly competitive and resilient — loves the chase and hates to lose
* High emotional intelligence and strong business acumen — you know when to push and when to pause

#### **Why You'll Love It Here**

* **Direct path to AE:** This role is designed to graduate into an Account Executive position
* **Elite mentorship:** Learn directly from top-performing AEs who know how to win

**Impact:** Your work will directly fuel Revivn's enterprise growth and shape the future of our book of business

If this sounds like you, apply! If you don't meet all of the qualifications but think you could be a match, we'd still love the chance to review your application.

We embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive environment. At Revivn, we encourage people from all ages, abilities, and experiences to apply. Revivn does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy or caregiver status, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

At Revivn, we prioritize transparency about our salary throughout the entire recruitment process. Be prepared to chat about compensation on your initial screen so that we can ensure alignment. If salary expectations and ranges are out of sync, we believe it is kind to respect everyone's time and may discontinue conversations.

But, here at Revivn, we ALSO believe in investing in the lifetime value of each individual we meet and interact with. (We love knowing good humans and supporting them in whatever they do). We know that if it isn't a good fit at the moment, it doesn't necessarily mean that it won't be a good fit in the future as we both continue to grow! We work to remain in contact with prospective candidates if the recruitment process ends early on.

For all job openings, we consider candidates with various backgrounds and levels of experience. When we give an offer it is based on individual skills and experience, as well as how that stacks up against other employees in the role. All of our ranges account for growth within the role, so in most cases, you should expect to join closer to the entry point of the band. You will have the opportunity to grow your salary over time.

The base salary for an ENT SDR is expected to be $70,000 with an On Target Earnings (OTE) between **$80,000 and $90,000/year**, including bonuses or commissions. Your exact offer may vary based on these factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, and experience. new_jobs.title: Social Media Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Social Media Manager is a hands-on member of the 9Rooftops Strategy team responsible for supporting the day-to-day execution of social media across a portfolio of client brands. The Social Media Manager ensures content is scheduled and published on time, performance is accurately tracked and reported, communities are actively managed, and influencer programs stay organized. This role works closely with social strategists, digital project managers and account teams, and provides the operational foundation that allows great social strategy to come to life in an agency environment.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Content & Publishing**

* Schedule and publish social content across platforms using approved content calendars and publishing tools.
* Ensure posts are accurately programmed, including copy, creative, tagging, links and publishing dates/times.
* Ensure content aligns with all defined best practices and has been proofed and approved before it is posted.
* Help maintain content calendars.
* Flag potential issues, missed deadlines or content needs to the appropriate team members.

**Analytics & Reporting**

* Gather and organize monthly social performance metrics across platforms.
* Build recurring client reports and presentations using established templates.
* Ensure reporting is accurate, timely and clearly organized.
* In partnership with the team, help identify notable trends, top-performing content and opportunities for optimization.
* Maintain reporting trackers and historical performance data.

**Influencer Support**

* Support the Senior Social Media Influencer + Strategist with tasks including:
  + Research and identify potential creators based on audience, content, brand fit and campaign needs.
  + Help coordinate communication and follow-ups with creators and partners.
  + Keep influencer projects organized from initial outreach through completion.
  + Track contracts, deliverables, invoices and payments as needed.

**Community Management**

* On behalf of a select number of 9Rooftops clients:
  + Monitor comments, direct messages and other social inquiries.
  + Respond to routine questions and comments in the brand's established voice, using the approved response matrix.
  + Escalate customer service issues, sensitive topics or questions requiring client expertise.
  + Maintain a timely and thoughtful presence across assigned social channels.

**Team & Strategy Support**

* Support the team with research, competitive reviews, trend tracking and other social intelligence as needed.
* Stay current on platform updates, emerging formats, creators, trends and cultural conversations.
* Help with administrative and organizational tasks that keep the team running efficiently.
* Enter time on a daily basis.
* Take on other projects and responsibilities as needed.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 0-3 years of experience in social media, marketing, communications, advertising or a related field; internships and relevant academic or personal experience are welcome (e.g., freelance work with existing small businesses).
* Strong interest in social media, digital culture and how brands show up online.
* Basic understanding of major social platforms, including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.
* Familiarity with social publishing or analytics platforms is a plus, but not required.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, presentations and recurring processes, or willing to learn.
* Strong written communication skills and good judgment.
* Able to manage multiple deadlines and priorities.
* Curious, proactive and willing to ask questions.
* Comfortable working collaboratively.
* Ability to follow all standard agency policies and procedures.

**What Will Make You Successful**

* Attention to detail: a broken link, incorrect tag or missed post doesn't get past you.
* Keeps things moving: you don't wait until someone asks for an update; you know what needs to happen next.
* Curious about the “why”: you're not just pulling numbers or scheduling posts; you want to understand what the data means and why the content is being put into the world.
* Plugged in: you naturally notice what's trending, what people are talking about and how brands are behaving on social.
* Good teammate: you communicate clearly, ask for help when you need it and make the people around you more effective.

The base salary for this position is $65,000, with the potential for up to an additional 20% if the applicant hired has additional related qualifications. Eastport Holdings offers a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life and disability coverage, HSA employer contributions, flexible spending accounts, employee assistance resources, paid time off, paid parental leave, and voluntary benefits designed to support your overall well-being.
